hypothesis: Separating the probability of the contractual target exit from the conditional payoff of all other exits may improve entry value over direct regression; expanding history is tested against a fixed252-date history. This is a registered hypothesis, not a claim of improvement.
contract: Same fixed6% protective stop, cent-rounded+5% target,14 inclusive calendar days, official sessions and stop-first ambiguous bars as v9. Entry at09:30 after the09:25:30 prediction and30-second latency. No learned early exit in any v12 arm.
features: Reuse verified causal25 signed/own/panel entry features from v9. The first input date is2024-11-12; no invented older history. Premarket receipt is a historical bar_end+1s assumption, not live received_at evidence.
training: Daily00:00ET, only entry dates whose BOTH ETF full14-day windows are complete and available strictly before cutoff; early winners are not released sooner than losses. Primary/direct/mean use ALL eligible historical dates;252-date two-part arm caps only its training/calibration eligibility. Each date contributes2ETF rows, each weight0.5.
algorithm: HGB classifier for target-exit flag and HGB squared-error regressor for log(1+net return) conditional on every non-target exit. Both:80 iterations,7 leaves,minleaf20,lr0.05,L2=5,no early stopping,seed814. Failure fit retains original0.5 weights and needs40 distinct failure dates; otherwise use ETF-specific training failure mean. A missing class uses empirical class probability. Win log-payoff is ETF-specific training target-exit mean. Direct HGB uses the same hyperparameters and dates to regress all net log returns.
prediction: For each ETF, g=p_calibrated*mean_log_target+(1-p_calibrated)*predicted_log_non_target. This decomposition predicts contract log payoff, not daily capital return, and is not a guaranteed profitability or optimal sizing claim. Mean arm predicts the ETF training mean log payoff.
calibration: Two-part p adds mean(hit-old_as_issued_raw_p) per ETF over latest60 mature forecast dates,min40,clipped[0.001,0.999]. Choose largest g first,tieSOXL; then add mean(actual_log_return-old_as_issued_g_of_top) over latest60 mature SCORE-READY top forecasts,min40. Candidate probability calibration and chosen-value correction are separate. Before either required calibration is ready, CASH; all old raw forecasts remain immutable. Direct/mean arms require only top-value calibration. No in-sample prediction may enter residual calibration.
decision: Buy only if corrected top log-value>0; otherwise CASH. One position; no same-day reentry;100% settled cash;T+1;dividends;cross-month MTM;unknown outcomes and occupied funds retained. No month-specific features,thresholds or policy switching.
stress: Same primary daily actions with double fees/slippage and own resulting barriers. No stressed training or action reselection.
development_screen: Do not open new case replay unless primary has complete marks/premarket coverage,at least10 completed actual trades,all4 development months nonnegative and arithmetic average>=10%. This research resource screen is not a replacement of the user's5/7/9 acceptance. Diagnostic arms cannot rescue the primary after results. Development history is already exposed.
acceptance: Specified5/7/9 monthly net capital arithmetic mean>=10%,allMay-Sep months nonnegative,complete coverage. Case months are development regressions,not independent future evidence. User goal cannot be completed from pre-May screening alone; future monthly losslessness is not guaranteed.
diagnostics: Matched continuous ledger comparisons and10-session circular block bootstrap5000replicates seed707; probability Brier/reliability,conditional non-target log error and chosen raw/corrected value bias. Report mature/unknown denominators and actual trade counts separately. All registered arms remain reported; no parameter sweep or winner promotion.
